addition.item: Back to Version Recursion prevention for {loadmodule}/{loadposition} is now user-controlled

change.item: XML-Feld show_featured an Core-mod_articles angeglichen (Werte: show/hide/only, default "show", validate="options", filter="integer" entfernt)
Helper auf einen einzigen setState('filter.featured', ...) Aufruf vereinfacht

fix.item: Parameter „Show Featured Articles" hatte keine Wirkung – behoben

note.item: Nach dem Update bitte jede Modul-Instanz einmal erneut speichern, damit der neue Optionswert korrekt abgelegt wird

Changelog metadata update (2026-11-06): Release notes are now maintained as XML and published centrally at https://github.com/joomlaplates-de/changelogs. This package includes its release snapshot as changelog.xml.

addition.item: Added include/exclude articles feature (modal_article field, like core mod_articles)

change.item: Recursion prevention for {loadmodule}/{loadposition} is now user-controlled
Previously articles with {loadmodule} were always excluded (memory overflow protection)
Admin can now decide per module instance whether to filter these articles

addition.item: Dispatcher-Klasse mit ModuleHelper::moduleCache() Caching (wie natives mod_articles)

change.item: Vollständige Migration auf native Joomla 5/6 mod_articles Architektur
Event-Dispatching via konkrete Event-Klassen (Content\AfterTitleEvent, etc.) statt $app->triggerEvent()
Event-Ergebnisse in $item->event->afterDisplayTitle etc. (stdClass, wie natives mod_articles)
Introtext-Verarbeitung (truncate, strip_tags) im Helper statt in Templates (displayIntrotext)

note.item: Kompatibel mit Joomla 5.x und 6.x ohne Compatibility Plugin

addition.item: Add Article Link to the Image Option

fix.item: Changes Prefix. All modules have now the "JP"-Module Name
Ready for J5 and J6 without compatibility Plugin

remove.item: Removed the XML version. Not needed anymore for J5 or J6

fix.item: Changed the xml path for updates
